links.comparator_used: Baseline LLMs without RAG (GPT Base, Gemini Base, Grok Base) relying on training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Clinician consensus alignment, automated Accuracy/Utility/Safety scores, and high-risk recommendation rate in pediatric myopia cases
links.effect: RAG models achieved 90-94% consensus alignment vs 68-82% for baselines; high-risk recommendation rate 0% in all RAG models vs 6-14% for baselines; GPT-RAG weighted automated score 7.46 vs GPT Base 7.37
links.quote: Crucially, the probability of high-risk recommendations-those capable of causing severe vision loss-was eliminated (0%) in all RAG models, whereas baseline models exhibited high-risk error rates of 6-14%.
